name: Vanilla bean, green (fresh, unfermented pod)
source: Fresh green Vanilla planifolia pod, before curing: illustrative high-moisture proximate (per kg) water 800 g, protein 20 g, fat 20 g, carbohydrate 140 g, ash 20 g — green vanilla is essentially odourless and very wet (curing chemistry literature).
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. Curing (origin/vanilla.ts: blanch, sweat, sun-dry, condition) is modelled as a real staged moisture-content reduction from this file down to vanilla-bean-cured's target, via the same technique agri/harvest.ts's dryGrain uses.
